K so I got this game and it was cool looking but first to say that the flipping is bad there is not really a good way to use it also it’s always on your right controller to use and can’t be changed to your left controller so it’s hard for me to use since I have stick drift in my right controller also people will play a round and then play the exact map and game mode always and it gets boating there is not many maps people camp in tag freeze  gets boring fast also there should be something for the zip lines since it’s easy to gain speed and to just fly off the map there is not a good way to have a timer on the screen for how long is left like it should always be on the screen also many times I have ran into the infected people due to it being somewhat hard depending on the map to see if there infected I have had issues also where my hand will clip through the ground and is hard to get back through since this game does not seem to have anti hand phase also tag feeze again is not the best when you tag people since I was the first infected and I tagged the same people  around 5 times in the freeze before there where finally infected and there is more I could say but no point since these are the main issues I don’t like

developer_response.body:
Thanks for the feedback. A few of these are actually already in the game, so let me help out.

Flipping can be turned off in settings if you don't like it. The round timer is there too, just hold A on your left controller to see it. And infected players have two big particle effects on them to make them easier to spot.

We're in beta so there's still a lot we're adding, more maps included. Zip lines are speed capped on purpose so you can't fly off the map. Camping is kind of the point of freeze tag, and there's already a delay so you can't tag someone the second they get unfrozen. The tag balance where it took too many tags to infect someone was fixed in the latest update, the infect timer is consistent now.

Not sure what's going on with the hand clipping through the ground, we haven't had that come up before. If it keeps happening let us know in the Discord and we'll look into it. Appreciate you playing.

This game is one of the best gtag fangames yet! It feels very modern, and one of the coolest features is the in game computer. You can actually use a mouse with it, which I’ve never seen in a Gorilla Tag fangame before. There are tons of game modes to choose from, along with plenty of settings to customize your experience. 
My favorite feature is the backflip setting it makes the game even more fun to play. The performance is excellent with no lag, and even though it’s currently in private App Lab beta testing, there are always lots of players online. Overall, this game is way above my expectations. It has unique features, great performance, and is incredibly fun to play. I highly recommend it 10/10

I was inside a lobby for the first time and it seemed pretty chill I really liked the style of the environment and stuff. But when someone was camping me I told him to stop camping then the round ended and I didn't think anything of it untill he started complaining and calling me slurs saying that he wasn't camping then another person came up to start calling me slurs as well. But that wasn't it because as soon as we entered a freeze tag game I was chosen to be it and it seemed like it would be a regular game, but I was very wrong because as soon as it started they started to bullie me but not just the 2 of them the entire lobby did they said stuff like "someone's mad" or " buddy's being ragebaited" and I know I could have left but I wanted to keep playing and I thought it would get better so I didn't it got really bad because they all went next to each other and started running so I couldn't get them and it was impossible to make them infected. They kept calling me slurs and I left after the match. It was a really bad first experience but I love how the game is and how it is played. 

So I think you should make it if someone gets freezed enough times they should get infected

developer_response.body:
Really sorry your first game went like that. That's not okay and it's not what we want the community to be. If it happens again, you can report the players in our Discord and we'll deal with it. We're working on making moderation better.

Also your freeze tag idea is actually really good. A whole group sticking together so the tagger can't catch anyone is a real problem and we're looking at auto infecting after enough freezes. Thanks for the feedback, and glad you like the game.
